_doc: SPOT metric map for emit_matrix.py (schema v2 — Bloomberg CODE + segment). Read off the newest snapshot (9/9/2026, 10 SPOT snapshots 2024-04-28 -> 2026-09-09). EVERYTHING IS IN EUROS (SPOT US Equity is Spotify’s ordinary-share NYSE listing (a foreign private issuer, not an ADR) and Bloomberg consensus is in EUR, scale M) — the dataset declares currency '€', so unit 'usdM' here just means 'millions, apply the scale token' (the engine's unit key), not dollars. Counts (MAU, subscribers) carry scale M and are passed through as millions of users. ARPU has a blank scale and is a per-user monthly euro figure, so it uses unit 'eps' (no scaling). Segment ids: Premium SEG0000454645 · Ad-Supported SEG0000454644 · Europe SEG0000340043 · North America SEG0000340046 · Latin America SEG0000340044 · Rest of World SEG0000340047. Total MAU has no segment. 'Premium Monthly Active Users' is Bloomberg's label for paying subscribers (the Premium segment's MONTHLY_ACTIVE_USERS), cross-checked: 3Q26 Street 305.2M = the 305M guide. BBG does NOT carry the quarterly guide, the Summit side does. The file is cp1252 now, not UTF-8: run through a patched copy or open with encoding='cp1252'. Added Oct 20 2026 for the canonical Earnings headline grid: ocf, capex (sign -1: Bloomberg stores spend as negative), dna and diluted shares (millions).
